title: SecondChance: Benchmarking Reliable Error Recovery in AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents make errors while they act, and their reliability depends on what they do afterwards. Existing recovery benchmarks mostly inject faults, involve no user and score whether the task is eventually completed, so they cannot show whether an agent undid its own silent error, told the user, or faced an error that could not be fixed. We introduce SecondChance, an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that profiles and measures error-recovery behaviour of AI agents. The errors are natural: they come from agents' own task attempts in $\tau^2$-bench, BFCL and AppWorld. Different agents then resume from the same checkpoints under one of four conditions: no assistance, an error notice, the error location, or repair guidance. We measure error correction, task success, policy compliance, preservation of environment state, repair durability and cost. We evaluate 12 models under all four conditions in 5,760 continuations. translated_title: SecondChance：对AI智能体可靠错误恢复能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: AI智能体在执行任务时会犯错，而它们的可靠性取决于犯错之后如何应对。现有的错误恢复基准测试大多通过注入故障来制造错误、不涉及用户交互，且仅评估任务最终是否完成，因此无法体现智能体是否能悄悄撤销自己的错误、是否会告知用户，或面对无法修复的错误时如何处理。我们提出了SecondChance，这是一个错误检查点数据集与评估框架，用于刻画和衡量AI智能体的错误恢复行为。这些错误是自然产生的：它们来自智能体在τ²-bench、BFCL和AppWorld中自行执行任务时的真实失误。随后，不同的智能体从相同的检查点出发，在四种条件之一的情况下继续执行任务：无任何辅助、收到错误提示、获知错误位置，或得到修复指导。我们衡量错误纠正、任务成功率、策略合规性、环境状态保持、修复持久性以及成本。我们在全部四种条件下评估了12个模型，共计5,760次任务续接测试。
tldr: SecondChance是一个基于智能体自身自然产生的错误检查点的错误恢复评估框架，通过四种不同辅助条件全面衡量AI智能体纠正错误、告知用户和修复任务的真实恢复能力。
en_tdlr: SecondChance is an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that benchmarks AI agents' error-recovery behavior from natural, self-generated errors under four assistance conditions, measuring error correction, task success, policy compliance, and repair durability.
